principalConclusion: ARA should preserve AraLearn's GPT/MCP authoring workflow while decomposing the monolithic agent configuration into versioned, administrable profiles, prompt templates, knowledge collections, context policies, tools, contracts and evaluations. Participatory observations and quantitative/qualitative analytics should feed auditable recommendations and diffs without autonomous mutation or scientific authority.
recommendedPath: Inventory the current AraLearn GPT instructions, knowledge, MCP tools, resource contracts and role workflows.
Define provider-neutral versioned objects for agent profiles, domain profiles, prompt templates, knowledge snapshots, context policies and eval suites.
Persist the complete effective agent configuration with every operation and research analysis.
Separate read context from write authority at card, microsequence and lesson scope.
Implement participatory observations as situated evidence with provenance, disagreement and human decisions.
Separate authoring/system analytics from educational/research analytics.
Treat LLM qualitative and quantitative analysis as reproducible research assistance with verified code, assumptions, multiple interpretations and human review.
Test one domain profile against AraLearn-equivalent behavior before expanding the profile catalogue.
provisionalProductCandidates: Quantitative, qualitative and mixed-method research workbench
preserveFromAraLearn: GPT/MCP planning, construction, audit, repair and re-audit roles
typed application gateway rather than direct database access
declarative JSON content and deterministic validation
persisted artifacts as the source of truth
separate: operational analytics from educational and research analytics
LLM recommendation from human approval and publication
deferred: final statistical and qualitative analysis engine
rejectedAsDefault: one monolithic GPT configuration for every domain and task
popularity or eloquence as observation authority
self-modifying prompts, knowledge or resources without review
natural-language statistical conclusions without executable verification
analytics collection without purpose, authorization and retention policy
